latest_cos_commentary.headline: Elo Touch Solutions is now part of Zebra Technologies and continues to sell OS-agnostic POS touchscreen hardware to restaurant software partners including Toast.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Direct pos_hardware competitor/potential supplier overlap: Elo hardware can run under third-party restaurant POS software, competing with Genius's own connected hardware line for the physical terminal layer.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Elo's integration into Zebra Technologies and its NRF 2026 product refresh (self-checkout, payment mounts, backpack PCs) signal continued investment in retail/restaurant hardware under new ownership.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect already runs Elo hardware under a competing POS, note that hardware and software are decoupled for Elo — a Genius switch does not necessarily require a hardware rip-and-replace, which can lower switching-cost objections.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Acquisition by Zebra Technologies was identified from a single vendor headline; deal terms, closing date, and post-acquisition financial health were not independently verified in this pass.
